head.title: Questions to Ask Before Choosing a Household Chef | myCHEF
head.h1: A Household Chef Selection Checklist for Dubai Families
head.meta_description: Before choosing a household chef, write down the meals, schedule and food preferences that matter to your family.

opening_paragraph: Before choosing a household chef, write down the meals, schedule and food preferences that matter to your family. Use these questions to assess the match and confirm responsibilities.

new_paragraphs: For a household plan, describe how many people eat at home, which meals matter most and how often you need the chef. For a private dinner, share the occasion, guest count and service time. Include your kitchen facilities and any access restrictions.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Discuss food preferences and household fit
replace_in_block.new_heading: Discuss food preferences and household fit
new_paragraphs: Share favourite cuisines, ingredients to avoid and the way you like meals served. Regular plans use a Food Profile to record preferences and help maintain consistency. A one-off event uses an agreed menu and service brief.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Review the chef and the selection process
replace_in_block.new_heading: Review the chef and the selection process
new_paragraphs: Ask how identity, right to work, practical ability and references are checked. Review the proposed chef profile and how availability is confirmed. For ongoing cooking, understand how feedback, cover and a change of match are handled.
Compare current visit and plan rates on the private-chef pricing page. Ask which groceries, transport, staffing and other items are separate, then confirm the scope in writing.

Compare the [private chef Dubai prices](/private-chef-dubai/pricing) for visits and 15, 30 or 45-meal packs. Choose one pricing method for the same cooking. For a celebration with event staffing and table service, request a separate private-dining or catering proposal.

Compare the complete service, including the menu, guest count, preparation, staffing, equipment, delivery and clear-down. A per-person price is useful only when the inclusions are clear. Ask which elements are fixed and which can change if your plans change.

Share allergies and other dietary requirements before confirming. The culinary partner should explain the preparation arrangements and any remaining cross-contact risk. Review the payment schedule, cancellation terms and change deadlines in your written booking.

Send the date, Dubai address, expected guest count and preferred service time, together with your menu ideas and venue details. Photos of the kitchen or service area can help the team assess what is practical.

myCHEF typically replies within 15 minutes between 9am and 9pm Dubai time. The tailored proposal follows once the requirements and availability have been reviewed. A first reply is an acknowledgement, rather than confirmation that a chef or date has been secured.
